files.name: quay_straight
notes: Wall occupies Blender y 8..9.5 (Unity z -8..-9.5), i.e. the 1.5 m water margin outside the cell's south edge; top flush at Z0; face drops to Z-4.

files.name: quay_corner_outer
notes: Walls lie outside the cell on the Unity S and E sides plus the rounded corner square.

files.name: quay_corner_inner
notes: Use on the land cell whose wall runs into the concave corner at its local Unity-east end; the neighbouring cell keeps a quay_straight.

files.name: bridge_span
notes: Deck top Z0 (8 m asphalt + 1 m walkways at Z0.15). Abutments fill the 1.5 m channel margins at both cell edges, continuing the quay line; arch springs from piers at |y|=5.8.

files.name: bridge_stub
notes: Broken deck ends reach ~2.2-2.8 m from each cell edge; coral/pearl barriers at |y|=6.65.

files.name: bldg_depot
notes: ANCHOR_cell_dock under the solar canopy at the front-right (viewer facing the door; Unity -X side).

files.name: bldg_substation
notes: SOCKET_cell sits inside the recessed housing on the north face (~1.1 m). PowerLights is a separate object (light bar + roof beacon, SKY_TealGlow).

files.name: bldg_terminal
notes: ANCHOR_convoy_stop on the road side of the north drop-off kerb (Unity z +7.0).

files.name: bldg_tower_control
notes: ANCHOR_lever at ground level just right of the door (viewer facing the door).

files.name: bldg_hangar
notes: Footprint 22.5 x 16 m (spans more than one cell in X); pivot at its own ground centre.

files.name: foldstation_kiosk
notes: LensRing pivot at the ring centre (Blender (0,-0.39,1.72)). ANCHOR_player is yawed 180 deg so its forward faces the kiosk.

files.name: atelier_platform
notes: Top of deck at Z0, radius 7 m; balustrade gap + 4 steps on the Unity-north edge.

files.name: atelier_pergola
notes: Shares the terrace origin with atelier_platform (centre, Z0).

files.name: plinth
notes: Top surface Z0.9, 1.6 x 1.2 m. ANCHOR_player 0.55 m south of the south edge, facing north.

files.name: plinth_tray
notes: Shares the plinth origin. SOCKET_slot_1..6 at each slot floor, west->east in Blender +X order.

files.name: switch_box
notes: Lever pivot = hinge (Blender (0,-0.235,0.72)); modelled up = OFF.

files.name: skyline_ring_piece
notes: Pivot at the ring centre; geometry spans a 30 deg arc at r~320 m centred on Unity north.

files.name: cliff_headland
notes: Plateau at Z-2.8 around the pivot; cliff foot at about Z-26.

files.name: dhow_small
notes: Pivot on the waterline (Z0) at mid-length; hull draft ~0.75 m.
